$comment: Target-role rubric for Keiko Coach. Encodes the IBM SRE Band Progression (Performance Expectations Guidance, Feb 2025) as the vacancy. dimension ∈ {outcomes,knowledge,proficiency,behaviors,scope}. supportType follows Irby (2018): knowledge/proficiency gaps → tutor; behaviors/scope/outcomes (leadership, brand, influence) → mentor. evidenceSignals are matched (substring, case-insensitive) against the candidate profile.
roleTitle: IBM Site Reliability Engineer — Band 10 (Thought Leader)

requirements.descriptor: Leads the formulation of SRE vision, roadmap and strategy; impact on divisional KPIs (Availability, MTTR, Adherence to SLO, Rate of Automation/Toil, % incidents detected by monitoring).
Solid contribution to cost controls of cloud spend at organizational scale.
In-depth knowledge of developing AND administrating in a multi-cloud environment; AI-driven self-healing / predictive failure mitigation.
Completed IBM SRE (L3) Thought Leader Certification and passed the Technical Leadership Review Board (TLRB).
Applied software engineering principles (Agile, Design Thinking) to enhance software reliability as an engineering discipline.
Giveback to IBM and Industry SRE communities through Mentoring, Intellectual Capital / IP, Speaking/Presenting, Teaching, Profession Champion, Mental Health Ally.
Established a personal brand across multiple SRE core skills; known as a thought leader in one or more SRE skills.
Leads functional strategy at the business-unit level; cross-org influence championing SRE features across Engineering, Support, Services and Offering Management.
